title: Regulatory Compliance Checker

what_happened: Someone used a chatbot to help with regulatory compliance by connecting Google Drive and walking through understanding and applying regulatory requirements. They reviewed and analyzed documents, identified gaps and conflicting obligations, and produced a compliance checklist. This job is a public pattern.
